definitions.gloss: evening drink at home; having a drink with dinner
definitions.explanation: The custom of drinking alcohol at home in the evening, typically with dinner or a light snack. A daily ritual for many adults in Japan, distinct from social drinking at bars or restaurants.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧{晩酌|ばんしゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: I enjoy an evening drink every night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{晩酌|ばんしゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一杯|いっぱい}→一杯：01793_ippai⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: My father has a beer with his evening drink.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わって→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ったら→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧、{晩酌|ばんしゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日課|にっか}→日課：00317_nikka⟧になっている。
examples.english: After work, my daily routine is to come home and watch my favorite TV shows while having my evening drink.

notes:
USAGE:
{晩酌|ばんしゃく} specifically refers to drinking at home in the evening, not going out to drink. It conveys a sense of relaxation and daily routine. The word has a warm, familiar connotation and is often associated with the image of a tired worker unwinding at home.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {晩酌|ばんしゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to have an evening drink)
- {晩酌|ばんしゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{供|とも} (accompaniment for one's evening drink — i.e., snacks)
- {晩酌|ばんしゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧ (to enjoy one's evening drink)
- {晩酌|ばんしゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}う→付き合う：02291_tsukiau⟧ (to join someone for their evening drink)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {晩酌|ばんしゃく}: evening drink at home (routine, relaxed)
- ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧: drinking party (social, at a restaurant or bar)
- ⟦{一杯|いっぱい}→一杯：01793_ippai⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧: to have a drink (casual, can be anywhere)
- {宅飲|たくの}み: drinking at home (modern slang, can be social)
